findings.text: follow-on: the recorded after_suite.failure_ids list tests/test_spa_composition.py::test_plans_surface_served_and_static_pages_request_only_their_own_origin, which appears in no FAILED line of the head-serve-tests.log it cites, while the log's own failing ids include tests/test_spa_composition.py::test_plans_surface_never_exceeds_its_window[1280] which the manifest omits; a reader deriving added_failure_ids from the manifest instead of the log computes a fabricated id, so the record and the log it names disagree.

follow-on: _text_compression_cache_path re-derives the same sha256(source\0identity)[:32] cache-path formula already owned by _thumbnail_cache_path at reckon/serve.py:2943, and _cached_gzip_text at :3061 repeats the read/compute/write_atomically/LOGGER.warning wrapper of _thumbnail_bytes at :3005, duplicating a per-revision blob-cache capability in two places instead of extending one owner; a third served-file cache will copy it again.

follow-on: the except OSError branch that still serves the compressed bytes when the cache directory is unwritable is exercised by no test, so a regression that raised there instead of returning would not redden any assertion the node added.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against 5b496700; commit f4737074 changes only reckon/serve.py (+85), tests/test_text_responses_are_compressed.py (+207) and the evidence fragment (+15), all inside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names a temporary-project test asserting gzip content-encoding with a body that decompresses to the file, the uncompressed passthrough, a 304 on If-None-Match, and no second compression; tests/test_text_responses_are_compressed.py:138-207 asserts all four and logs/gate-text-compression.log records 5 passed EXIT=0.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to gzip text responses sent by _send_file above the size threshold when the request accepts gzip, caching per revision; reckon/serve.py:3312-3327 does exactly that in _send_file.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records commit f4737074, the gate at 5 passed EXIT=0, the negative control red at EXIT=1, and baseline/after suite receipts, though its after_suite.failure_ids list a test that appears nowhere in head-serve-tests.log.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the source manifest declares reckon/serve.py, tests/test_text_responses_are_compressed.py and the evidence fragment (plus an unused docs/figures directory); the 5b496700..f4737074 diff touches exactly the three source files.

justifications.durability: tests/test_text_responses_are_compressed.py:138-160 reddens on the negative control that removes the compression branch, but the OSError fallback at reckon/serve.py:3072 that serves compressed bytes on an unwritable cache has no test.
justifications.evidence: logs/gate-text-compression.log ends EXIT=0 with 5 passed and logs/negative-control-text-compression.log ends EXIT=1 with the Content-Encoding assertion red, but the manifest's recorded after_suite.failure_ids do not reconcile with the head-serve-tests.log it cites.
justifications.fit: reckon/serve.py:3048-3085 mirrors the established _thumbnail_cache_path/_thumbnail_bytes idiom at :2935-3027 in docstring, typing and write_atomically use, and introduces no plan, ticket or version name.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/serve.py:3312-3327 gzips a text response above _GZIP_MIN_BYTES when the request accepts gzip and caches the bytes per revision keyed by the same identity that builds the ETag, which is the goal verbatim.
justifications.reuse: reckon/serve.py:3057 re-derives the sha256-truncated path formula already used by _thumbnail_cache_path at :2943 and _cached_gzip_text at :3061 repeats _thumbnail_bytes at :3005, so the per-revision cache capability now lives in two near-identical pairs without a shared owner.
justifications.scope_discipline: git show --stat 5b496700..f4737074616d lists only reckon/serve.py, tests/test_text_responses_are_compressed.py and docs/evidence/fragments/the-site-answers-fast-and-agrees/text-responses-are-compressed.html, all three declared in the manifest.
